details:
Description

After joining your friend's room, if you choose to go to another room, the menu list will show that the friend's room is set as a private room, but in reality, the friend's room is still an open room or a friend's room. This seriously affects the gaming experience.

Reproduction Steps

After joining a friend's room, if you then choose to visit another room and try to view the friend's room again, it will show as a private room status and requires an application to join. However, in reality, the status of the friend's room has not changed. This is a very serious bug that affects the gaming experience. This bug did not exist before the update of the UI.

Details

- Category: 用户界面

- Frequency: Always
